scope: Irish-resident individual direct-share portfolio; fixed-current-rate historical scenario; research for model design, no account actions

sources.title: Revenue Tax and Duty Manual 19-07-01: Annual exempt amount, reviewed December 2024
sources.quote: after deducting any losses available for current and earlier years
sources.finding: The EUR1270 annual individual exemption is applied after current and carried allowable losses. Each spouse/civil partner has an exemption; unused exemption is not transferable to the other. The model must not choose to preserve carried losses while consuming the exemption.

sources.title: Revenue Tax and Duty Manual 19-02-05: Allowable losses, updated December 2024
sources.quote: after deducting any allowable losses of that year and any unrelieved losses for an earlier year
sources.finding: Current losses then prior-year losses reduce gains before the personal exemption. Losses generally cannot be carried back to an earlier tax year. The examples explicitly use current and prior-year losses before the EUR1270 exemption.

sources.title: Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 section 581
sources.location: subsections 1-4; enacted text, read alongside current Revenue guidance below
sources.quote: acquired within 4 weeks preceding the disposal
sources.finding: Subsection 1 identifies recent acquisitions before a disposal. Subsection 2 applies FIFO to the excess. Subsection 3 restricts a loss when same-class shares are reacquired during the four weeks after disposal; it does not state a corresponding restriction for a gain. Spouse/civil-partner related rules require separate checking if a second owner is introduced.

sources.title: Revenue Tax and Duty Manual 19-04-03: Disposals of marketable shares and securities, reviewed August 2023
sources.quote: a loss on the sale will be allowed only against gains derived from the disposal of the shares re-acquired within four weeks
sources.finding: Revenue confirms the directional distinction between a purchase before sale (share matching) and a purchase after a losing sale (restricted loss relief). A partial repurchase proportionately restricts the loss. No explicit primary-source endorsement of same-day winner harvesting was located.

sources.title: Revenue TCA Notes for Guidance, Finance Act 2025 edition, Part 19
sources.quote: the shares acquired in the 4-week period are treated as the shares actually disposed of
sources.finding: Current Revenue notes retain preceding-acquisition and subsequent-loss-repurchase distinctions. Ordinary FIFO is subject to section 581. Do not model US-style free choice of tax lots.

sources.title: Revenue: How to calculate CGT
sources.quote: The rate of CGT is 33% for most gains.
sources.finding: The personal exemption is EUR1270 per year. Acquisition/disposal costs can be allowable expenses. Tax gain is calculated on the gain, not gross sale proceeds.

sources.title: Revenue: When and how do you pay and file CGT?
sources.quote: you must pay CGT by 15 December of the same year
sources.finding: January-November disposal CGT is due 15 December that year; December disposal CGT is due 31 January following. Return due 31 October following disposal year, including disposals with no tax due. Existing backtest reserves tax contemporaneously and settles annually; that is not the statutory payment calendar.

sources.title: Revenue Guide to Completing 2024 Pay and File Tax Returns
sources.finding: The guide explicitly allows a refund when tax was paid on an initial-period gain and a loss arises in the later December period. Do not finance November taxes with hypothetical future December losses.

sources.title: Revenue: Dividend income, published August 2026
sources.quote: You are liable to tax on the gross dividend at your marginal rate of tax.
sources.finding: Dividends are income rather than ordinary CGT gains, with Income Tax, USC and PRSI according to circumstances. Foreign dividend withholding can be reduced or relieved under a DTA; it must not simply be added to the entire Irish marginal rate without available credit.

sources.title: Ireland-USA Double Taxation Convention
sources.location: Article 10(2)(b), PDF page 13; Article 24(4)(a), PDF page 33
sources.quote: 15 percent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases
sources.finding: Treaty-eligible ordinary individual portfolio dividends have a 15% source-tax cap, and eligible US tax receives Irish credit subject to the applicable rules. Existing settle_us_dividend already assumes treaty relief and a withholding credit; do not count that existing relief again as new alpha. Non-US issuer dividend tax still needs issuer-specific treatment.

model_recommendations.rule: On a fixed late-year actual trading session, calculate additional positive EUR gains needed using only realised current gains/losses and carried losses. Realise enough positive matched-lot gains to reach current losses plus carried losses plus EUR1270, subject to eligible unrealised gains and transaction-cost safeguards. Use partial FIFO sales rather than whole positions to avoid crossing into taxable gains. Recompute after every trade.
model_recommendations.details: Rank eligible positive FIFO prefixes by gain per euro traded to minimise turnover, or overweight/departed positions first for index fidelity. Never select lots freely across the holding. Avoid any same-class purchases in the preceding 29 days if the engine has not implemented recent-acquisition matching. Year-end schedule must remain in the intended tax year when markets are closed.

model_recommendations.status: Reasoned interpretation of statute, not an explicit Revenue safe harbour
model_recommendations.rule: Permit only after sale, with every matched lot showing nonnegative gain after costs, no same-class prior-29-day acquisition and no open restricted-loss condition. Repurchase creates a new lot at actual cost and fees; preserve sale-before-buy execution order.
model_recommendations.details: Section581(1) is about preceding purchases and581(3) about losses. Thus an ordered positive-gain sale and subsequent repurchase is consistent with the directional rules. No primary guidance explicitly resolves all same-day ordering issues was found. A next-session repurchase removes same-date ambiguity but incurs real exposure risk and should be priced at that later session, not retrospectively at the sale price. Conservative underweight replacement with 29-day exclusion is another sensitivity.

model_recommendations.rule: Loss harvesting and exemption gain harvesting should share one annual tax budget. Apply losses before exemptions; additional loss harvesting can consume gains otherwise sheltered by an expiring exemption.
model_recommendations.details: For a causal loss sale, require available eligible net loss after costs and a fixed minimum loss/benefit threshold. Use genuine market sales and prohibit same-class repurchases for at least29 days after each loss sale. Match eligibility before the disposal; do not use future gains or future recovered prices to trigger a trade. A marginal-benefit variant can harvest only enough to reduce tax already accrued, leaving no redundant loss sale once current liability is zero. This may trade less than maximum-loss strategies.

model_recommendations.rule: A loss sale and same-exposure replacement reduce basis by approximately the loss realised. If the loss is merely carried to final liquidation, the lower basis raises the terminal gain by the same amount; that is not a second permanent tax benefit.
model_recommendations.details: Loss harvesting creates deferral when it offsets an actual current CGT liability; portfolio/exposure changes can have separate gains or losses. Exemption harvesting can provide permanent relief up to EUR1270 times33%=EUR419.10 per fully used additional year before costs. The 2010-2026 study touches17 tax years, with the2026 exemption already consumed at terminal liquidation, so no more than16 extra prior-year allowances (EUR6705.60 at fixed33%) exist. Wealth differences above that are not all exemption tax savings.

model_recommendations.strategy: Fresh-cash rebalancing and cost-aware tax budgets
model_recommendations.status: Already partly implemented; refine without hindsight
model_recommendations.rule: Use contributions and after-tax dividends to fill current underweights before realising taxable winners. Rank planned disposals by incremental current CGT and trading cost, respect FIFO and avoid uneconomic microtrades.
model_recommendations.details: Use observed EUR proceeds and historical EUR basis. Losses, exemptions and taxpayer-level gains outside this account must be model inputs. Broker unrealised USD loss alone does not identify an Irish taxable loss.

model_recommendations.status: Already included in baseline ordinary US dividend assumptions
model_recommendations.rule: Maintain treaty eligibility and correctly credit source withholding. Do not treat15% US withholding plus52.35% total Irish marginal rate as67.35% combined tax.
model_recommendations.details: Do not manufacture a new15% alpha improvement where the existing model already credits withholding. A low-dividend portfolio tilt would alter index exposure and expected returns, so it must be reported as a separate portfolio strategy rather than guaranteed tax alpha.

out_of_scope_without_new_personal_facts: Using another person's allowance is not assumed. Spouse/civil-partner ownership, transfer rules and related-share acquisitions require explicit household facts and different account scope.

Pension wrappers change contribution relief, ownership, withdrawal taxation and access timing. They are a separate comparison, not a drop-in tax adjustment to this16-year liquid personal-account model.
Automatic forced acquisitions after a loss sale can trigger restricted-loss rules even where voluntary buys are blocked; audit and disclose these separately.

A new higher realised loss total is not by itself evidence of higher after-tax wealth or a better strategy. Compare final net wealth, fees, gross exposure effects, exemption actually used and tax actually deferred.
